quests.name: Fish in a Bucket
quests.objective:
I'll reward anyone who makes my life a bit easier... I enjoy doing as little as possible, mon!

Below the docks here in Shadowprey Village, I've many shellfish traps. If you're kind enough to do my work and collect me my shellfish, then I'll reward you with something you want... get my drift mon? For every five shellfish you bring me I will give you a fine Bloodbelly fish!

quests.name: Bone Collector
quests.objective: Bring 10 Kodo Bones from the Kodo Graveyard to Bibbly F'utzbuckle at Kormek's Hut.
quests.description:
We're sitting on a goldmine here, I tell you - a goldmine! Kodo bones will change the world forever... I have customers making furniture, music instruments, and even blasting powder out of them.

There's a caravan that comes by and picks up my Kodo bones and then sells them at Shadowprey Village. If you can travel to the kodo graveyard south of here and bring me ten Kodo bones, I'll give you something in return. Is it a deal?
quests.progress: Do you have the bones? The caravan will be here any moment. I need just ten more kodo bones to reach a career high. A career high, I tell you!
quests.completion:
Ah, goodie! My bones!

I can't wait till the chaps at home see my face on the front cover of Goblin'preneur. I'll be the richest goblin in the world... and my physical education teacher said I would never amount to anything.

quests.objective: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and return a Conqueror's Crown from the Badlands to Warug in Magram Village.
quests.description:
As the strongest centaur clan in all the land, we deserve armaments with ferocity that matches our strength!

Warug needs one most of all. A helm... no, a crown! A conqueror's crown! I heard legends of a fearsome conqueror across the seas. Go to a place they call the Badlands and seek out a crypt there. Return to me only when you have found the crown.

Do this for me, and I will reveal the Magram's greatest strength.
quests.completion:
Look at this! Look at it! What a crown! Befitting of a Khan... but to be worn by Warug. I am pleased.

Are you ready to learn the Magram's newest weapon against our foes?

quests.name: Khan Jehn
quests.objective: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and slay Khan Jhen at Magram Village. Once you have succeeded, report to Uthek the Wise in Gelkis Village in Desolace.
quests.description:
As much as I would like Uthek or Khan Shaka to give the order, I fear our window of opportunity is short. Too short to consult those at Gelkis Village.

I believe with the situation unfolding here at the Valley of Bones that the Magram have left Khan Jehn with minimal defenses. If there was ever a time to attack another clan's Khan, it is now.

But <name>, a Khan is not to be trifled with, least of all Jehn. If you are brave enough to make your move, you must be swift but do not underestimate him.
quests.progress: I felt a shift in the wind as you approached. Do you bring good news from the Valley of Bones?
quests.completion:
Khan Jehn has been slain!?

I do not believe it. I cannot believe it. This was brazen! Foolish! Nerlokh had no authority to suggest such an attack!

Yet, if you are speaking the truth, I cannot deny that the defeat of Jehn bodes well for the future of our clan. A new Khan will soon take his place, but we have time to prepare our next move.

I will speak with our Khan. For now, your work here is done. Bask in today's victory, but do not tempt fate further.

quests.name: Economic Warfare
quests.objective:
One thing that war has taught us: money is power.

All centaur in Desolace have come to an agreement to barter with intricately carved wood that shares tales of a centaur's own glory and conquests. It serves as the only reprieve from battle, and only the most level-headed are permitted to engage with other clans.

I have seen your kind trade in gold and silver. Worthless to us, as our totems are to you. Bring me some, and the Magram Clan will be pleased.

quests.name: Economic Warfare
quests.objective:
Long ago, all of the centaur clans in the Desolace agreed to trade in story. Specifically, carved totems that represent an individual or clan's great accomplishments. Despite the endless conflict, all clans continue to honor this tradition, even if trade opportunities between us have become few and far between.

Should you collect any, such as from fallen centaur of other clans, bring them to me. The Gelkis can use more bartering power, and I will inform the Khan of your assistance.
